"""Shared configuration values for the transcode upload worker."""

BANDWIDTH_LIMIT_KBPS = 800
CHUNK_SIZE_KB = 256
JOB_TIMEOUT_MS = 45_000
RETRY_BACKOFF_MS = 1_500
MAX_RETRIES = 3
SLA_SUCCESS_THRESHOLD = 0.98
STORAGE_ENDPOINT = "storage.internal.example"

"""Runs individual upload jobs with retry and backoff handling."""
import io
import time

import config
import metrics
import uploader


class UploadError(Exception):
    pass


def run_job(job):
    job_metrics = metrics.JobMetrics(job.job_id)
    job_metrics.start()
    attempt = 0
    succeeded = False
    while attempt <= config.MAX_RETRIES and not succeeded:
        try:
            sink = io.BytesIO()
            uploader.upload_file(job, sink)
            succeeded = True
        except (OSError, UploadError):
            attempt += 1
            if attempt > config.MAX_RETRIES:
                break
            backoff_seconds = config.RETRY_BACKOFF_MS / 1000 * attempt
            time.sleep(backoff_seconds)
    job_metrics.stop(succeeded)
    return job_metrics
